bibl.title: New insight from a teacher's manual: the word-lists of codex Papyrus Chester Beatty 1008 and the practices of ancient educators.
bibl.seg: Sean A. Adams, New insight from a teacher's manual: the word-lists of codex Papyrus Chester Beatty 1008 and the practices of ancient educators.
bibl.note: Re-evaluates the word-list codex P. Chester Beatty Inv. 1008 (= MP3 2751; LDAB 5508; S.B. XII, 10769), arguing that PCB 1008 is best understood, not as a school text completed by a student (so ed. pr.), but is a unique example of teacher's handbook, one that was in the process of development.
